description: Score a resume 0-100 with ResumeAI's production ATS engine — the same one behind https://withresumeai.com/ats-checker. Returns a breakdown (keywords, format, sections, content, length), concrete fixes, and missing keywords. Optionally pass a target company (to get that employer's verified ATS + vendor-specific parsing rules) and/or a job description (to score keyword overlap against the posting). Rate limited to 10 checks per day per IP; pass a paid api_key ($49/mo at https://withresumeai.com/developers) for unlimited calls.

api_key.description: Paid API key (ra_live_...) — lifts the 10/day IP cap. Get one at https://withresumeai.com/developers

ats.description: Target ATS vendor, e.g. 'Workday' — adds vendor parsing guidance

company.description: Target employer, e.g. 'Nike' — adds its verified ATS + parsing guidance

job_description.description: Job description text — switches scoring to keyword overlap against it

name: check_resume
title: ATS-check a resume
